Require fixed-work, fork-exclusion, re-exec negative and raw perf time_running/time_enabled ratio. Separate whole inherited PMU covers full command tree.

A only has the baseline compatibility operation. Re-execute the landed rank_variants runtime fixture on the original current source outside clocks; A has no scorer. Run C too. admission.include: real authenticated A/B/C/D, unchanged locked registry, same canonical root/cargo/SDK path, inert environment, isolated network, native runtime and ABI fixture, full original four-state source and upstream unit test, exact current six real kernel rustc lib argv plus all other execs, zero true compiler launches and zero changed stable products on an unchanged A/B/C/D. Bind actual six outputs, all workspace metadata members/public sidecars, all crate target features and dependencies. Require own independently cold B/C/D to agree on rooted native metadata including allocation table, full seeds and opposite-version stale-cache refusal as appropriate. Same-parent normal/traced/scoped/whole/bare byte equality on .rmeta, public sidecars and fixed outputs. First discrepancy stops that run.

admission.wall: Blocking wait4/pidfd without timeout polling; independently armed watchdog and native short-child calibration. Direct ordinary process, no ptracer, no extra flags or log chatter.

On this very workflow independently prove warm B/C/D semantics equal fresh B/C/D on all workspace .rmeta units and public-hash sidecars. Fallback to production 10d56274 (+#318 alone) only on a replicated signed CTFE failure: stable failure except public allocation hash, exact byte-independent native typed tables including allocations + unchanged extern topology, source and behavior; repeat twice including a fresh A stock and independent cold B/C/D; require corrected role to pass the same checks. Unexpected failure ends the trial. Label comparison precisely. No clocks before role election.

Qualify the preregistered six-unit source projections/most recent signed Cargo on that exact new source and on the new real workflow first. Never attribute an uncorrected result to a corrected binary.

pairs.seeds: 16 independently constructed cold A directories, one per compiler per pair. Equal paths; mount/swap entire toolchain directories without recopying the launcher. One source tree, complete B→C→D in every restoration. Immutable verified A snapshot (cold receipt, unchanged A); restore independently before each acquisition. Sidecar and branch guard on every exit, including C. Never substitute a numeric zero for any absent SDK/command.

scope: plain Cargo package check and six normal library rustcs. No uv patch, wrappers, explicit Rust flags, test build, linker or debug logging in bare or inherited-Cargo visits.

score.failure: Run all eight after successful eligibility even if the threshold becomes impossible. An absent/multiplexed/invalid/mismatched observation prevents a scored claim; no replacement pair. Show partial and raw original.
score.per_edit: Report independent B/C/D raw values and paired medians, counts above 1 and 2, both holds, separate B+D and full B+C+D. A single-edit reproducible 2× claim additionally needs its own 8/8 >2 and both holds on two hosts (Holm family over B,D,B+D); C stays descriptive.
score.per_rustc: 12 fixed code-edit×library tests (B,D times six); meaningful if all eight T/P strictly below 4/5 and each hold median <4/5; exact FWER Bonferroni 12/256<0.05. Report every count, every PID/raw evidence and failures, C is descriptive. Sum six and all-process Cargo separately. No substitution of guest or wall for retired counters.
score.primary: For each pair, ratio (P_B+P_D)/(T_B+T_D) in blocking wall nanoseconds. Both production edits. Must have all 8 ratios strictly >2 and both independently prespecified four-pair medians >2. Exact one-sided sign p=1/256 only when all 8 cross the bar. A qualifying original starts a genuinely independent eight-pair host with identical criterion, alternation reversed; retain failed pilots.
